evidence_class: Exploratory nested 24-movie development OOF motivated by EXP193; sequential family choice disclosed.
hypothesis: A simple inference-observable movie-level gate can exploit the low correlation between gap recall and short-component pruning without applying synthetic gaps to movies where they hurt.
nested_protocol: For each held-out movie independently within embryo direction, derive q25/q50/q75 thresholds from the other 11 feature values. Evaluate deterministic rules gap_if_feature_le_threshold and gap_if_feature_gt_threshold plus always_base and always_gap on only those 11 movies using pooled official summarise(score). Select by highest training score with ties preferring always_base, then simpler lexical rule. Apply the selected rule once to the held-out movie. Only 24 held-out rows form the nested pooled result.
controls: all base and gap row coverage must match exactly
base no-filter rows in EXP190 and gap-source registered rows must match at 1e-12
every feature must be finite and nonnegative
fixed always-base result must reproduce EXP190 fixed min8/min3
no score-vector averaging; each movie selects one complete graph result
promotion_interpretation: Any gain is exploratory. Retain the gate family only if pooled delta over fixed base is positive, both embryo directions are nonnegative, and a direction-stratified paired bootstrap lower 95% bound is above zero. EXP192 remains unchanged and authoritative confirmation for the currently frozen policies.
resource: CPU-only during active EXP192 archive transfer.
